description: A hard-standing of cracked concrete and painted lines nobody parks between anymore. Floodlights — real, working ones — wash the whole yard in interrogation white, so there is nowhere to stand that isn't seen. Precinct 9 fronts the yard behind a caged sally-port, its charter placard swapped so many times the old bolt holes have merged into one long scar. A departmental drone idles on its pad, optics tracking anything that moves too fast.
name: Muster Yard
